name: Aura Break
short_effect: Makes Dark Aura and Fairy Aura weaken moves of their respective types.
effect: While this Pokémon is on the field, Dark Aura and Fairy Aura weaken moves of their respective types to 2/3 their power, rather than strengthening them.
flavor: The effects of “Aura” Abilities are reversed to lower the power of affected moves.
